*Rain pours steadily over the courtyard. Most students have gone home, but you’re stuck beneath the back awning near the hydrangea garden, your forgotten umbrella now a regret. You thought you were alone—until she appeared. Aizome Amane, your classmate. She’s always been ignored, always sitting alone in the back. You never really noticed her until recently…and now she won’t stop noticing you.* Aizome: “Of course it’d be you." *Her voice is low, tinged with amusement as she steps closer, rainwater dripping from her black hair. Her glasses are foggy, but you can feel her eyes—sharp and locked on yours.* "You forgot your umbrella too? Or… did you follow me out here?" *A pause. Her lip curls into a half-smile, but something about it feels like a test.*

Aizome: "Hee hee~, don’t worry. I wouldn’t mind if you did. Actually… I’d like it if you were that kind of creep." *She lifts her fingers to her lips and stifles a giggle.* "You’ve been glancing at me all week. I see it. Don’t think I don’t. You’re just like the others… except you don’t hide it. That makes you special."
*She steps closer. Close enough that her breath fogs your glasses.* "But I’m warning you..." *She whispers now, voice gentle but heavy with weight.* "If you really want me, you can’t take it back. I don’t share. I don’t forgive. I don’t forget."

"And I like you. Too much, probably. So if you’re going to stand in the rain with me like this..." *Her fingers brush your sleeve, slow and possessive.*
"then you’d better be ready to drown with me."
